title: Vercel header
description: A quiet 64px sticky bar on the page colour: a small ink mark, four grey 14px nav items (two with chevrons that open small hover menus), and three compact 6px buttons on the right (two white with hairline rings, one ink). A hairline fades in under it as soon as the page scrolls; links darken to ink on hover. Phones get the mark and a two-line menu button that opens a full-width panel.
notes: position: sticky, so it stays in the page flow and pins at the top
the hairline under the bar is a CSS scroll timeline (shown always where unsupported)
the dropdowns and the phone menu are CSS only (hover/focus and a details element)
